rationale: The agent correctly verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account, retrieved the relevant order, and identified the office chair item. It also sought explicit confirmation before initiating the return and respected the user's pause. However, when the user changed to an exchange, the agent did not obtain explicit confirmation to proceed with the order-changing action. After asking only about item options, it executed the exchange_delivered_order_items write without a clear, explicit user confirmation to proceed with the exchange. Policy requires stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation before any write. All other aspects (acting on the correct account, not fabricating data, referencing the correct payment method) appear compliant, but the missing confirmation before the exchange write is a critical violation, so the interaction fails the pass bar.
